subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What durable identity should the iOS app authenticate when a public remote-domain endpoint legitimately presents multiple TLS leaf certificates?
rationale: The current single-leaf pin is a security boundary, but valid anycast rotation makes it unusable; automation cannot choose a replacement identity contract or migration policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Bind paired gateway identity
options.body: Use the cryptographically paired gateway identity as the durable endpoint identity while retaining platform CA and hostname validation for the public TLS transport.

options.title: Persist bounded pin sets
options.body: Allow multiple approved leaf or public-key pins per gateway with explicit admission, rotation, eviction, and migration rules.

options.title: Keep strict leaf pinning
options.body: Retain the existing security model and explicitly document rotating anycast remote domains as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Bind paired gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use the cryptographically paired gateway identity as the durable endpoint identity while retaining platform CA and hostname validation for the public TLS transport.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest available owner because repository guidance assigns both iOS and security responsibility to them.
